, in a small town, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved to play with her soft toy cat. One day, Lucy and her cat went to the park. They played on the swings and the slide.
Suddenly, Lucy heard a sound coming from a small box in the corner of the park. She opened it and found a tiny kitten. The kitten was very dirty, but Lucy didn't mind. She picked it up and showed it to her mom. "Look, mom! A cat!" she said.
Her mom smiled and said, "That's wonderful, Lucy! Let's take the kitten home and see what happens." So, they took the kitten home and gave it a warm bath. The dirty cat became clean and happy. Lucy was happy too.
The moral of the story is that even when things get hurt, we can always find new ways to bring happiness to others.
